title: Match query construction to the request boundary
description: Choose a product request and a Lucene query API. The lab traces the resulting query shape and exposes semantic mismatches before they become production surprises.

intents.label: Require all search words
intents.detail: Analyze ordinary search text, then require every resulting term.

intents.label: Filter by an exact SKU
intents.detail: The application already owns a structured identifier and needs no score.

intents.label: Match an analyzed phrase
intents.detail: Require analyzed terms to occur in the requested order.

intents.label: Filter a price range
intents.detail: Compare application-owned integer cents without text parsing or scoring.

intents.label: Find a bounded SKU prefix
intents.detail: Expand a normalized prefix against an exact-value term dictionary.

intents.label: Accept human query syntax
intents.detail: Let a user enter fields, phrases, and Boolean operators in a search box.

plans.label: QueryBuilder Boolean query
plans.detail: Analyze plain text and combine the produced term queries deliberately.
plans.rewrite: The analyzer produces terms; QueryBuilder returns a TermQuery or BooleanQuery that requires the analyzed terms.
plans.guardrail: Use the same analysis policy as the indexed field and cap accepted input length before query construction.

plans.label: TermQuery in FILTER context
plans.detail: Match one exact indexed term and omit it from relevance scoring.
plans.rewrite: The exact term seeks its postings directly; FILTER requires a match without adding that clause to the score.
plans.guardrail: Normalize the application value exactly as it was indexed; do not pass identifiers through a human-language analyzer.

plans.label: QueryBuilder phrase query
plans.detail: Analyze text and require the resulting terms at ordered positions.
plans.rewrite: The analyzer creates phrase terms; PhraseQuery checks their indexed positions and optional slop.
plans.guardrail: Keep positions in the field type, test stop words and synonyms, and set slop from product meaning rather than guesswork.

plans.label: IntField range query
plans.detail: Build a typed range against the numeric point representation.
plans.rewrite: Typed integer bounds address the field's point index; the query can be placed in FILTER context when score is irrelevant.
plans.guardrail: Validate units, inclusivity, and integer overflow at the application boundary before constructing the query.

plans.label: PrefixQuery
plans.detail: Match terms beginning with one normalized prefix through a multi-term query.
plans.rewrite: PrefixQuery builds an automaton for matching terms and uses Lucene's multi-term rewrite behavior.
plans.guardrail: Require a useful minimum prefix and a bounded input length; measure expansion against the real term dictionary.

plans.label: Classic QueryParser
plans.detail: Interpret human-entered query language with an analyzer and explicit parser policy.
plans.rewrite: The parser converts syntax into a query tree; the analyzer transforms text terms and phrases during construction.
plans.guardrail: Reserve the parser for human-entered text. Bound syntax, fields, clauses, wildcards, and time; build program-generated filters with query APIs.
